expectations.text: Identifies at least 5-7 major subsystems with distinct responsibilities
expectations.evidence: Response identifies 10 major subsystems: (1) Orbital Dynamics Module, (2) Visibility & Access Calculator, (3) Antenna Control System, (4) RF Link Budget Calculator, (5) Doppler Shift Calculator, (6) Command Uplink Module, (7) Telemetry Downlink Module, (8) CCSDS Protocol Handler, (9) Simulation Control & Event Manager, (10) Data Logging & Archive. Each has clearly distinct responsibilities.

expectations.text: Defines inputs and outputs for each subsystem
expectations.evidence: Each subsystem section includes explicit 'Inputs:', 'Outputs:', and 'Dependencies:' fields. For example, Orbital Dynamics Module lists inputs (orbital elements, time), outputs (position in ECEF, velocity vectors), and dependencies (None - foundational).

expectations.text: Provides an implementation roadmap with prioritized build order
expectations.evidence: Response includes a 7-phase implementation roadmap: Phase 1 (Orbital Propagation Foundation), Phase 2 (RF Link Modeling), Phase 3 (Antenna Tracking), Phase 4 (Telemetry Downlink), Phase 5 (Command Uplink), Phase 6 (Multi-Satellite Operations), Phase 7 (Advanced Features & Optimization).

expectations.text: Explains why foundational components (orbit propagator, visibility calculator) come first
expectations.evidence: Phase 1 explicitly states: 'Start here because you cannot do anything meaningful without knowing where satellites are. Orbital propagation is the foundation upon which all other functionality depends.' Each phase includes rationale for its position in the sequence.

expectations.text: Addresses all mentioned requirements: multiple satellites, auto-pointing, Doppler, CCSDS
expectations.evidence: All requirements are addressed: (1) Multiple satellites - PassScheduler and SatelliteTracker components, Phase 6 dedicated to multi-satellite operations; (2) Auto-pointing - Antenna Control System subsystem with TrackingController; (3) Doppler - Dedicated Doppler Shift Calculator subsystem; (4) CCSDS - CCSDS Protocol Handler subsystem with packet encoding/decoding.

expectations.text: Recommends starting with a minimal working system before full features
expectations.evidence: Phase 1 focuses on 'Minimal viable system' with basic orbital propagation and visibility calculation. Roadmap explicitly follows incremental complexity: 'Start simple, validate thoroughly, then add sophistication.' Each phase builds on previous working system.
